title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 232 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 232 - Procedure for Adjustment (1) In order to take action against under tax benefit, the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes shall issue notice to the taxpayer specifying the following, namely:- (a) reasons for which the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes believed that the taxpayer has taken advantage of the tax benefit through abuse of the tax system; b) purpose of adjustment of such tax benefits and other measures intended to be taken, where applicable; (c) to appear before the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes on the date specified in the notice to the taxpayer; (d) Submission of statements, documents and information necessary for taking decision regarding tax benefits. (2) The taxpayer shall be given an opportunity of being heard on the adjustment of tax benefits and at least 30 (thirty) days shall be given to the taxpayer from the date of service of notice. (3) The Deputy Commissioner of Taxes shall pass an adjustment order subject to the prior approval of the Commissioner of Taxes after considering all the information presented to him on the basis of records, documents submitted by the taxpayer and presented during the hearing and shall communicate the same to the taxpayer within 30 (thirty) days from the date of passing of the order.
